18-collapsible-tree-search.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Tol palette with rank-colored nodes, clean search UI, and confident whitespace make this feel designed, but the tree occupies only the top half of the viewport leaving a large dead zone below.
18-collapsible-tree-search.encoding_integrity_note: Tree layout with purely categorical/topological encodings is structurally honest — data-driven SVG dimensions, correct rank color encoding, no quantitative size deception — but key functions use fragile name+depth string concatenation instead of stable ids, risking join corruption if data includes same-name nodes at equal depth.
18-collapsible-tree-search.stress_test_note: No .interrupt() call before any transition in update(), so rapid clicks during expand/collapse or search will cause mid-flight snapping; all other concerns (search is debounced 200ms, pointer events unify mouse/touch, no cross-view dispatch, no brush/zoom scale closures) are handled correctly.
18-collapsible-tree-search.cognitive_load_note: Progressive disclosure keeps the default view to ~15 nodes across 3 levels, the 6-color Tol palette maps cleanly to the legend, and count badges (+37, etc.) communicate hidden depth without expanding it — cognitive load is well-managed; full expansion to ~200 nodes could create vertical density but is user-initiated and scrollable.
